data.one_liner: WordPress and WooCommerce JSON API client for user authentication, management, and customer data.
data.what_it_does: Connects Flutter applications to WordPress and WooCommerce backends using the WP JSON API plugin. It handles user sign up, login, profile management, WooCommerce customer data, and points/rewards.
use_when: You are building a Flutter app backed by a WordPress or WooCommerce site using the WP JSON API plugin.
You need standard user authentication (login, register, reset password) with a WordPress backend.
You need to fetch or update WooCommerce customer info and loyalty points.
avoid_when: Your backend is not WordPress or WooCommerce.
You are using a WordPress plugin version older than 5.0 (unless you stay on older package versions).
strengths: Provides typed exceptions for specific WordPress REST API error codes.
Built-in secure token storage and session management.
Supports WooCommerce customer details and Points and Rewards.
weaknesses: Tightly coupled to a specific WordPress plugin (WP JSON API 5.0+).
Admin actions and role updates must be managed server-side.
data.setup_notes: Requires installing the WP JSON API plugin (version 5.0 or later) on your WordPress site.
